case_name: Securing an AI Assistant for SOC Operations

risks.title: Prompt injection changes assistant behavior or suppresses escalation
recommended_controls: Treat alert text and retrieved documents as untrusted input
Test prompt injection across alerts, URLs, command lines, and documents

risks.title: Sensitive security or identity data leaks through outputs or logs
recommended_controls: Block secrets before submission where practical

risks.title: Assistant tool access modifies cases or workflows without approval
recommended_controls: Require human approval for ticket updates and notifications
Log all tool calls and denials

risks.title: Service identity has broader data access than required
recommended_controls: Scope access to approved workspaces and indexes

risks.title: Analyst accepts unsupported AI output as verified incident fact
recommended_controls: Add approval gates before final incident updates

risks.title: Audit logs do not capture AI-specific events
recommended_controls: Log prompt category and session metadata
Capture source documents and tool calls
Capture denied actions and approval identity

risks.title: Knowledge-base poisoning influences assistant guidance
recommended_controls: Track source freshness and approval status

required_before_production: Risk acceptance documented by authorized owners

evidence_boundary: Simulated portfolio evidence only. No real customer data, production prompts, credentials, tenant IDs, tokens, or live incident records are included.
